GOOD TO KNOW

Questions & Answers

What is Minlabs?

Minlabs is a personal project lab where curious or exciting ideas are built and launched right away as everyday apps and web services.

What is shashak?

shashak is a to-do and routine app where you track today's tasks, daily habits, recurring schedules, and a monthly calendar alongside a squirrel companion while earning acorn rewards. It works offline right out of the box without sign-up, supports native iOS and Android Home and Lock Screen widgets, and you can interact with the squirrel directly on the shashak website.

What is ToePick?

ToePick is a TOEIC study app for iOS and Android that lets you practice Listening (Parts 2, 3, 4) and Reading (Part 5) questions, check detailed explanations, and review essential vocabulary in one seamless flow. Visit the ToePick website for details.

Do I need to install an app to use IMMYME?

No installation is required. You can use IMMYME directly in your mobile web browser—simply allow location access or pick a neighborhood to start getting recommendations.

How can I contact Minlabs for support or inquiries?

Please email support@minlabs.app with the service name (shashak, ToePick, or IMMYME) and your message.
